summary: Shopify Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the results of its 2026 annual general meeting, covering the election of 10 director nominees, the appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as auditors, a non-binding advisory vote on executive compensation, and a shareholder proposal regarding AI policy. The filing is a routine disclosure of shareholder voting outcomes as required by Item 5.07 and Item 8.01. There are no special-situation elements such as a merger, acquisition, activist campaign, or strategic review. This is a standard current report on ordinary corporate governance matters, with no deal terms or unusual structural features.
